result.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
result.comment: 30 pages. To appear at NeurIPS 2026 (extended version)
result.summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多目标强化学习中目标权重冲突导致的学习效率问题，提出目标冲突系数与在线 regret 界，并设计维护少量基策略、动态路由轨迹的路由集成方法，以及用核代理估计轨迹间相互影响的轨迹归因算法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核代理轨迹归因刻画轨迹间的协同与对抗，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配、筛选与训练数据取舍提供评价线索；路由集成对小规模基策略的动态选择亦可供核查是否能类比 latent 推理中的计算分配，但跨域迁移性尚未验证。
